prompts.pachas:
Use case: identity-preserve / compositing.
Asset type: company-branded professional portrait for a personal work card.
Edit target: Image 1 is Arturo Vela's original portrait. Image 2 is the official positive horizontal Pacha’s Café logo extracted from the supplied brand manual. Image 3 is its approved monochrome white variant.
Primary request: adapt this same portrait for Pacha’s Café with the supplied brand colors and official logo.
Scene/backdrop: restrained dark teal studio backdrop in #255652, with a small flat terracotta #E04B2D accent and warm cream #FDCB9E used sparingly. No gradient effects on the logo.
Subject: preserve this exact person's identity, face proportions, glasses, hair, skin tone, expression, navy suit, white shirt, and tie. Keep natural skin texture; no beautification, aging, reshaping, or cartoon effect.
Composition: opaque 3:4 vertical portrait. Reserve a clean strip above the head for the supplied white horizontal logo, centered and legible. Whole hair, ears, face and chin must fit safely between 25% and 70% of total height. The top 75% square crop must contain the entire logo and entire face, with generous margin. Upper body below; face forward, same pose.
Brand treatment: composite the supplied official white logo accurately, preserve symbol, lettering, apostrophe, accent and slogan geometry; never redesign, rotate, stretch, or invent lettering. Exact brand name “PACHA’S CAFÉ”, slogan “De la pacha, lo mejor”. Use approved all-white version on teal backdrop.
Constraints: edit background/brand composition only; keep recognizable identity and clothes. No new people, objects, website, contact text, role text, borders, watermarks or UI. This is a portfolio portrait of past professional experience, not an advertisement.
